name: Ban Zhao
shortBio: Han-dynasty Chinese historian and Confucian philosopher who completed the Book of Han and authored Lessons for Women (Nüjie), advocating classical education for women within Confucian moral cultivation.
centralQuestion: How can women cultivate Confucian moral virtue, scholarly literacy, and intellectual authority within classical family and civic ethics?

keyWorks.title: Lessons for Women (Nüjie)
keyWorks.description: Influential Han Confucian treatise arguing that women require equal intellectual education alongside men to fulfill moral and familial duties.

keyWorks.title: Book of Han (Hanshu)
keyWorks.description: Monumental dynastic history and philosophical chronicle of the Western Han completed by Ban Zhao.
